text:
jamie: Heads-up: opening a short PR to deprecate the `X-Region` examples and replace them with `x-redwood-region`. Mostly docs-only but want a quick ops + legal check before merge.

rita: Thanks. Can you call out the migration steps? I found a few older tutorials still using `X-Region` in the quickstart.

matt: Yes — propose 3 steps in the PR: 1) update SDK snippets (Node/Go/python) 2) add a note about header normalization in Node fetch/axios 3) add a one-line mapping table showing `X-Region` -> `x-redwood-region` and mention older clients may still send the old header.

jamie: Good. Also adding a tiny table of common region codes (eu-west-1, us-west-2, ap-southeast-1) and a link to the live endpoints page.

legal: Please avoid implying legal guarantees. Replace wording like "data stored in EU" with "requests will be routed to EU-preferred endpoints when available" and add the standard sentence: "Guaranteed data residency is available only under specific contractual arrangements." I can sign off on that phrasing.

rita: ops check: is the gateway still honoring both headers? I remember a change to canonical lowercase.

ops-bot: infra note: gateway accepts both `x-redwood-region` and `X-Region` for backward compatibility but canonical is `x-redwood-region`. Responses include `x-redwood-routed-region` when routing deviates.

matt: For the Node snippet I added a short example showing Headers object to avoid key-casing pitfalls:```js
const headers = new Headers({
  'authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`,
  'content-type': 'application/json',
  'x-redwood-region': 'eu-west-1'
});
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat', { method: 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify({input: 'hi'}) });
```

jamie: Also included CLI troubleshooting steps (internal): `rwctl trace <request-id>` and `rwctl routes inspect <request-id>` with a short example of checking `x-redwood-routed-region` in the response.

docs-ci: Preview build: https://docs-preview.example.com/branch/region-header-deprecate (build 1189) :rocket:

rita: Looks good. One nit: update the migration note to say "update any saved curl snippets or SDK examples" — lots of customers copy & paste.

matt: Updated. Also added a small FAQ entry: "What if my request goes to a non-preferred region?" Answer: check `x-redwood-routed-region` and contact support if you need a contract.

legal: LGTM with the residency phrasing change.

jamie: PR filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4387 — requesting reviews from @rita @matt @legal. Plan to merge after CI and legal sign-off.

rita: After merge can someone run a quick repo grep for `X-Region` and open follow-ups? I can pick the sweep if needed.

matt: I'll do the grep and file follow-ups for infra-owned samples. Command I used: `git grep -n "X-Region"` then open PRs for matches.

jamie: Thanks all. Merge once green and legal acked. :thumbsup:
